## Work Order Board

A kanban of Work Orders, one column per status from Requested to Cancelled. It wraps the catalog `Board` with the Work Order status graph: a drag between columns is checked with `canTransition` against `WorkOrderStatusField`, and a move the graph does not allow (in progress straight back to requested, for example) is refused, so the card snaps back to its column.

Dropping a card into Scheduled stamps `scheduledFor` with today when it has none. The board writes the new status onto the Work Order and calls `onChange` so the host can save it; it runs no query of its own and shows exactly the `workOrders` it is given.

### Non-goals

Not a planner: dates are edited on the Maintenance Calendar or on the Work Order itself.
